Name: Merib-baal, Son of Jonathan
Summary: Son of Jonathan and father of Micah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:34; 1 Chronicles 9:40: Son of Jonathan and father of Micah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Merib-baal stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
